parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Your development request lists the provider as Other but doesn't name it, so it couldn't be routed for approval.

Please submit a new request with the provider's name filled in.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Reminder: development request awaiting your approval – @{triggerBody()?['Author']?['DisplayName']}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
This request has been waiting @{mul(variables('MgrWaits'), 3)} days for your decision.

Requester: @{triggerBody()?['Author']?['DisplayName']}
Program: @{triggerBody()?['Title']}
Provider: @{triggerBody()?['Provider']?['Value']} @{triggerBody()?['VendorName']}
Total cost: @{formatNumber(float(coalesce(outputs('Compose_-_TotalCost'), 0)), 'C2', 'en-US')}

You can respond from the original approval email, the Approvals app in Teams, or the Approvals page in Power Automate.
